prompt:
A 1980s Indian living room on a Sunday morning: a wooden television cabinet with sliding shutter doors open, the screen showing colour test bars, a lace doily and a vase on top, a sofa with cushions, a ceiling fan, sunlight through a window. Painted like a 1980s Indian family-magazine illustration in flat gouache: warm teak browns, faded teal and cream with one signal orange, soft grain, nostalgic Sunday light. Wide interior composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same room carries on, quieter and dimmer: a plain painted wall, a doorway, soft shadow. It is one continuous painted room with no panels, no split, no dark band and no second picture. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
